pr_target: dev (no PR — commit direct per AIPLA workflow)

features.description: useResizableWorkspaceRatio hook + DEFAULT_RATIOS constant + sessionStorage I/O helpers. Returns [ratio, setRatio] pair. setRatio writes to sessionStorage on commit. On mount: read sessionStorage for key 'aipla.workspaceRatio:<skillId>'; if absent, fall back to DEFAULT_RATIOS[skillId] ?? 0.50. SSR-safe (no sessionStorage read at render time).
acceptance_criteria: Hook returns [ratio, setRatio] with ratio: number in [0.30, 1.00]
DEFAULT_RATIOS maps problem-set-hints->0.50, led-planck-tutor->0.55, kinebot->0.65
Fallback default 0.50 when skillId not in map
sessionStorage key shape: aipla.workspaceRatio:<skillId>
Calling setRatio writes to sessionStorage immediately (or on next tick)
Module imports cleanly under SSR (no window references at top level)

features.description: WorkspaceDivider component: 4px-wide vertical bar with a 12px hit zone, cursor: col-resize. Pointer drag updates a ratio prop via onChange callback. Snap zones at 0.30, 0.50, 0.70, 1.00 with ±2.5% snap range. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/Right adjust by 0.05, Home/End jump to min/max, Enter toggles between current value and 0.50. ARIA: role=separator, aria-orientation=vertical, aria-valuenow/min/max. prefers-reduced-motion suppresses the snap-flash animation.
acceptance_criteria: Drag from any X position updates ratio via onChange
Ratio is clamped to [0.30, 1.00] (passed-in min/max props)
Snap engages when within ±2.5% of a snap point
Snap-flash CSS animation fires on snap commit
Keyboard a11y: ArrowLeft/Right +/- 0.05, Home/End -> min/max, Enter -> toggle 0.50
ARIA attributes match spec (separator role, valuenow/min/max)
prefers-reduced-motion suppresses the snap-flash

features.description: WorkspaceShell accepts ratio + onRatioChange props. Renders WorkspaceDivider as first child of aside (absolutely positioned on left edge). Aside width is style={{ flexBasis: ratio * 100 + '%' }} on md+, w-full below md. Renders ChatRevealTab (left-edge tab) when ratio === 1.0 to set ratio back to 0.50. Preserves the existing collapsed-strip flow entirely.
acceptance_criteria: WorkspaceShell takes ratio + onRatioChange + skillId props
Aside flex-basis matches ratio on md+; w-full below md
Divider rendered inside aside, left-edge
ChatRevealTab visible only when ratio === 1.0
Collapse-strip flow unchanged (chevron, 8px strip, restore on expand)
Below md: divider hidden, ratio not consulted

features.description: Chat page wires useResizableWorkspaceRatio(skillId). Conditionally hides the chat panel when ratio === 1.0 (display: none on md+, leave alone below md). Passes ratio + setRatio + skillId to WorkspaceShell. Single hook invocation at the top of the component; same hook output threaded into both Boldkast and LED Planck workspace blocks.
acceptance_criteria: Chat page reads [ratio, setRatio] from useResizableWorkspaceRatio(skillId)
Chat panel hidden on md+ when ratio === 1.0
Below md: chat panel always visible (tab pattern unchanged)
Both Boldkast and LED Planck workspace blocks receive the ratio + handler
skillId passed to WorkspaceShell on both branches

features.description: Vitest suites for the three new units. useResizableWorkspaceRatio: default lookup per skillId, sessionStorage round-trip, fallback default. WorkspaceDivider: drag math (ratio computation from pointer delta + parent rect), snap zones (snap at ±2.5%, no snap outside), keyboard (Arrow/Home/End/Enter). WorkspaceShell integration: divider mounted, ratio prop drives aside width, ChatRevealTab renders only when ratio===1.0.
acceptance_criteria: useResizableWorkspaceRatio: 4+ cases (defaults, fallback, sessionStorage read, sessionStorage write)
WorkspaceDivider: 6+ cases (drag, snap zones, no-snap outside zone, keyboard each binding, ARIA, prefers-reduced-motion)
WorkspaceShell: 3+ cases (divider mounted, ratio drives style, ChatRevealTab gate)
All cases green via npm run test:run
No regression in BoldkastSimFrame, LedPlanckLabFrame, LedPlanckWorkbench tests
